# /crav1-record-approval

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Record a person's yes](../../from-record-approval.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-record-approval/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Record a named person's yes on an Approval needed item, after accept in this run.

**[`/crav1-record-approval`](crav1-record-approval.md)** (1.141.0) shows the `Approved:` line, the constraint that still asks for the yes, and the tasks that line unblocks. It writes the line only after `accept` in that run. An earlier quote does not count. The source date and the accepted date both stay. It does not send, apply, tick a task, or commit.

The line is `Approved: <person>, <source date>, <source>, "<quote>" (accepted by <recorder> <date>)` under `## Approval needed`. No skill removes it. A live `apply` still needs the user's own yes in the build run.

1.144.0: the spec folder command is `<interpreter> -X utf8 <skill crav1-tasks-ready-to-build>/scripts/resolve_spec.py "<query>" --root docs/specs`. `show` and `write` pass `--root`, `--person`, `--source-date`, `--source`, `--quote`, `--recorder`, and `--accepted`. `write` also passes `--yes`. On Windows `<interpreter>` is `python` with `PYTHONUTF8=1`. Elsewhere it is `python3`.

## Choice words

Exact words for bots and scripted runs (no `--flags`). A word in the invocation takes that choice without asking. A headless or bot run with no word stops and names the valid words.

| Question | Word | Means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Write the line | `accept` | write the Approved line shown in this run |

## Runs when

You have a person's yes to record on an Approval needed item. Called by the user.

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 2 (the most prompts in one run, the closing yes included). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: One spec's Approval needed items, its constraints, and tasks.md.

Reads `## Approval needed`, `## Constraints`, and `tasks.md` for the spec the user named.

## Writes

In short: One `Approved:` line under that item, after accept.

After `accept` in this run, appends one `Approved:` line under that item. The script is `scripts/approval_needed.py write --yes`. It keeps the file's line endings.

## Does not

Leaves the item, `Person:`, `Holds:`, `Asked:`, `Pending:`, the constraint, plan, tasks, code, and every other spec line alone. Sends nothing. Does not apply. Does not commit.

Limits and exceptions: No item, or two items, stops and lists them. It does not invent an item. A headless run without `accept` stops and does not write. It names [`/crav1-build-tasks`](crav1-build-tasks.md) for the tasks it unblocks and does not run it. It is not a starter option.

- You run next: [`/crav1-build-tasks`](crav1-build-tasks.md); [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.
